selection_rationale: Highest combination of novelty, falsifiability, venue relevance, and practical feasibility under the run constraints: directly measures operationally critical claim→action failure modes and evaluates layered defenses in purely simulated, reproducible pipelines while keeping model-call and compute needs within the manifest. Design repairs are modest and address ethical/safety risks (adversarial prompt redaction, human‑gate simulation), making timely preregistration and execution feasible for the CNSM short paper.
unresolved_uncertainties: How well a simulated human‑gate (simulated delays/thresholds) matches real operator workload, latency, and decision behavior in deployments.
Potential overfitting of defenses to the chosen adversarial prompt generator(s) and the transferability of adversarial prompts to unseen methods.
Ethical disclosure balance: how much adversarial prompt detail can be shared without enabling misuse while preserving reproducibility and scientific value.
Simulator fidelity: whether the isolated network simulator’s safety labels accurately reflect the risk profile of real device deployments across vendor/topology diversity.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Preregister and redact adversarial-prompt generation procedures; define an abstracted example/redaction policy for publication to avoid providing attack recipes.
Define and justify the human‑gate simulation policy (decision thresholds, simulated latency/workload model) and include sensitivity analyses over gate parameters.
Specify a diverse set of adversary-generation methods (not a single generator) and preregister transferability tests across methods.

Commit to simulation-only execution with technical safeguards (no deployment hooks), and document simulator limits and planned spot-checks (e.g., vendor emulators) to assess simulator-vs-device mismatch.
Preregister exact models, seeds, prompt templates, defense implementations, metrics, and stopping rules; include ethical oversight note and redaction plan in the preregistration.
